items.name: Wreck Sighted (Levels 30 to 80): tutorial text pass (chart-loop lines out, companions line, grant scene, proofread)

objectives.description:
The Ghost Ship hung over this coast longer than anyone's grandmother could remember. Now she has come down.

A salvager mends a net by a driftwood fire below the wreck. "Another one come to pick her bones. Sit, then. Ask."

She nods at a board of driftwood where she pins what the sea gives back. "Ask what you came to ask."

Pick a topic. You can come back to this board after each answer.

nextObjectiveId.text: How do I get aboard her?
What do you want with salvage?
I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Nobody goes aboard alone. She won't let you. Bring two friends, or two beasts you trust."

The Wrecks open Friday 6 PM to Monday 6 PM Central in sector 210. You can't enter alone: bring 2 teammates or 2 pets. You and 2 pets can clear it, but it's very hard. Lose a fight and the run ends.

"She broke in two. The near half is faded and gentler. The far half still remembers every order."

The Faded Skyglass Wreck (sector 210, 7/1) is for levels 30 to 80, so every fight there is sized for you. The Skyglass Wreck (21/6) is the endgame hull, for 81 and up. Each band takes its own Wreck Sighted to get in.

"The Wreck wants company: two friends, or two beasts you trust. A chart doesn't. Take one and walk the run alone."

Every chart opens a run you take alone, from the Battle Arena. Two new ones drop in the Faded Wreck: Split Hold and Broken Stern, both open from level 30.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Coin, stores and paper. Charts, wet ones, drawn by the crew themselves."

Every clear pays ryo, EXP and Wreck Salvage, and can drop charts. The endgame hull also drops the rarer charts, ledger pages, the Lantern and a shard.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Each chart is the way into one corner of her, and she doesn't hold still, so it's good once."

Take a chart to the Battle Arena and run it alone; claim any waiting reward first. The chart is spent when the run starts. Health and chakra carry from fight to fight, and a lost fight ends the run.

"The deep ones I've seen a handful of times. The gold-edged ones, twice."

Epic: Glass Nursery, Sealed Reliquary, The Fall, and every Haul page. Legendary: Rotted Reliquary, Burning Heading, The Drowned Cradle. Both Wrecks drop charts; the Skyglass Wreck drops the rarer ones.

"The low-tide charts take you to the lower decks. Below are the crew's own: what they buried, the works, the archive, the helm. Those lead to the doors they sealed."

Charts can drop in the Wrecks, and salvage buys more from her. The Archive pays an Archive Chart Case: a Foundry or Captain's Watch chart, rarely a sealed chart or the Lantern.

nextObjectiveId.text: What do I get for winning?

objectives.description:
"The crew marked every chart by how deep it goes. The plain ones wash up every tide."

Common: Low Tide Run, Night Watch, Rotted Galley, Split Hold. Rare: Buried Cache, Drowned Foundry, Quarantined Archive, Captain's Watch, Spoiled Hold, Broken Stern. The rarer the chart, the more salvage a win pays.

"Win, and the crew lets you choose what to carry out."

A winning ending lets you pick one reward from a short list, and pays EXP and salvage. Some runs end in a last room: leave with what you hold, or press on and keep only that if you lose.

"The crew sealed their crates well. Prying them open is half the fun."

A Skyglass Coffer holds Filament, Serum, a Crown Fragment or, rarely, the Skyglass Katana. A Sealed Treasury holds ryo, Imperial Gold, Rare Jewels and Unobtanium. Crown's Hoard holds a Coffer, a Treasury and a Skyglass Token. Unmarked Cargo could be anything.

"Pills, kunai, dried fish. They ate better than we do."

Medicine Inro: healing and chakra pills. Sage's Strongbox: battle potions and rarer pills. Elemental Tool Pouch: Elemental Kunai and tools. Galley Stores: 2,000 EXP for an eligible active pet. Little Horror's Jar, a rare drop from the endgame Wreck, is the event's pet.

"The glass itself is worth more than anything they packed, if you know how to work it."

12 Skyglass Filament craft a Skyglass Crystal, and 5 Fragments of the Skyglass Crown craft The Skyglass Crown. Both need a crafting rank; without one, trade them to someone who has it.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Some doors the crew sealed. The Reliquary Seal opens the reliquary. The Last Heading takes you back to the night she fell."

These are the Epic runs, The Sealed Reliquary and The Fall. Their charts drop now and then from the Quarantined Archive, the Captain's Watch, Crownhold and Archive Chart Cases, and the salvager trades one a week for 20 salvage.

She looks past the fire, at the black water. "Deep enough, and she stops being a ship."

Ask about the doors the crew sealed, the Haul, the Mender's hold, or what lies under Crownhold.

nextObjectiveId.text: What did the crew seal shut?

objectives.description:
"Soak a sealed chart in Core Rot and the rot remembers the place worse."

Use an Epic chart from your inventory with 3 Core Rot, then win one fight. You get the tainted chart: a harder run where you pick 2 rewards. Lose, and the chart comes back but the Rot is spent. Core Rot drops from the endgame Wreck, the low-tide runs, The Fall and the tainted runs.

"Some come back from the deep with a lantern that won't go out. It points at the mountain, at Crownhold, the castle she sailed from. Someone still gives orders there."

A Lastlight Lantern opens Crownhold. It drops from the Epic and tainted runs and rarely from the endgame Wreck and Archive Chart Cases, and, from level 80, the salvager trades one a week.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Some bring back a ledger page or a stores list and go after holds no chart shows. They come back heavy, or not at all."

A page opens The Haul: up to 5 steps of crate, locker or cut through. Deeper, bigger chests of profession materials. Leave after any step to keep them; lose a fight and you keep nothing. Pages drop from the endgame Wreck and the Rare runs.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Down in the lower hold, the ship's carpenter is still at work. He mends the hold shut around anything that doesn't belong. That's you."

Chart of the Drowned Cradle: a Legendary run for level 81 and up, alone, in the Battle Arena. It drops rarely from the Skyglass Wreck and the Spoiled Hold.

nextObjectiveId.text: How do I get past him?

objectives.description:
"Mind your feet. The hull closes in a band at a time, and the seams light up first."

Three fights: his apprentice, the bilge crew, then The Hullbound Mender. Glowing seams mark the next band a turn early. Grown hull shuts off bloodline passives, healing and new buffs. A win pays salvage and a pick of rewards.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Four of them brought me shards. Different hands, same glass. Lay them side by side and they ring."

Keel: the endgame Wreck. Crown: Crownhold. Tide: the Epic and tainted runs. Ledger: The Haul.

"Under Crownhold the stair stops where the rock does. Something beneath it listens back."

One of each shard opens The Mother of Echoes, the last fight, in the Battle Arena. Alone, over three battles; health and chakra carry with no refills. All four shards are spent when it starts; a loss returns nothing.

"Beat her, and the shore will know it. Some names stick."

Winning The Mother of Echoes grants the title The Unstilled.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Bring me what you pull off her. Brass, glass, rope. I pay in charts."

Every Skyglass win pays Wreck Salvage, and so does her shore work. Trade it to her for more charts. It keeps between weekends and can't be traded to other players.

nextObjectiveId.text: How much does a win pay?
Can I trade what I find?

objectives.description:
"The far hull pays best. The near half gives little, and not every time."

Skyglass Wreck: 3. Faded Wreck: 1, one clear in four. Chart runs by rarity: common 1, one win in four; rare 1; epic and Haul pages 3; legendary 5. Crownhold: 10. Watch Log challenge: 3. Dailies: 1 to 5.

"Four pieces for a deck chart. Pick the one you want."

Deck chart, 4 salvage: Tide Chart (opens The Low Tide Run), Watch Roster (The Night Watch), or the Buried Cache or Rotted Galley chart, each opening the run of its name.

"Ten for one from the hold. The crew drew those deeper."

Hold chart, 10 salvage: the Drowned Foundry, Quarantined Archive, Captain's Watch, Glass Nursery or Spoiled Hold chart. Each opens the run of the same name.

"The sealed charts and the Lantern, once a week. I don't find many."

Sealed chart, 20, once a week: a Reliquary Seal (opens The Sealed Reliquary) or The Last Heading (The Fall). Lastlight Lantern, 30, once a week, level 80: opens Crownhold.

"Clear my nets and I'll pay you. Something's always tangled in them."

Take a trade from the Wake Island board, from level 30. The salvage is taken when you start. Beat the Netted Husk, then pick your chart. Back out before the fight and she gives it all back.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"Shore work, if you want it. Echoes on the tideline, warm glass in the pools, wreck to comb, and a warden still counting."

Four dailies from her in sector 210, open to all: Beachcombing pays 1 salvage, Warm Glass 2, Echoes Ashore 3, The Tideline Count 5. Lose a fight and the run ends.

"One job at a time. Whatever the tide brought in."

Find her in sector 210. She offers one of the four: Beachcombing 40%, Warm Glass 30%, Echoes Ashore 20%, The Tideline Count 10%. Each offer uses one of your 20 daily NPC rolls, shared with every NPC. You hold one at a time: finish or drop it to roll again.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"What you can't use, trade. Every chart and every shard has a buyer."

Charts, Core Rot, Haul pages, shards and Skyglass Tokens can be traded. Crown's Hoard, Unmarked Cargo, Wreck Salvage, the Haul's chests and some once-only rewards cannot.

"The crew's colors still take to steel."

A Skyglass Token unlocks one Skyglass skin, once, on a weapon you already own: Aetherion, Thornsilver, Night's Testament, Stormrender, Oathbinder, Ink of the Void, The Unwritten, Gaea's Embrace, Warden's Bracers, Eclipsed Dawnblade, Zephyr's Whisper or Yuki's Frostbite. A boss's own token unlocks that boss's skin.

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description:
"I keep their watch log. It washes up a page at a time. I dry one each weekend and pin it up in the Administration Building."

Two pages go up each weekend: one for levels 30 to 80, one for 81 and up. Your band's Wreck Sighted hands you yours. Take it first: only what you do while you carry it counts.

"One watch's orders. Lately the name at the top isn't one of theirs."

Five challenges, in any order. Each pays its reward plus 3 Wreck Salvage; claim it from your Logbook. Finish all five for a Skyglass Token. The page closes Monday 6 PM Central (00:00 UTC Tuesday).

nextObjectiveId.text: I'm ready. Give me the chart

objectives.description: Back to the fire

She pulls a Tide Chart from her coat, still damp at one corner. "Low tide opens her lower hull. Don't sit on it. She's already changing shape."

Trades and the watch log page are on the Wake Island board. Her shore work is in sector 210. To hear all this again, take At the Salvager's Fire on the board.

She stops, the chart still between you, and looks at you properly for the first time.

"What did you say your name was?"
She doesn't answer. The net slides off her knees. Her lips move, shaping your name again without a sound, and she glances up at the Wreck as if it might have heard.

She draws a folded page from inside her coat, salt-stiff, the ink run at the edges. Her hand isn't quite steady.

"This turned up on the shore this morning. Dry, when nothing else was. And with your name on it."
This weekend's page of the watch log. It is in your Logbook.

She folds the chart into the page and presses both into your hand. "Your name's on it now. Bring it back."

Levels 30 to 80: this page and the Faded Wreck. Neither Wreck can be entered alone: bring 2 teammates or 2 pets. One player with 2 pets can clear it, but it is very hard.
You have your first chart.

"Some doors the crew sealed. The Reliquary Seal opens the reliquary. The Last Heading takes you back to the night she fell."

These are the Epic runs, The Sealed Reliquary and The Fall. Their charts drop now and then from the Quarantined Archive, the Captain's Watch, Crownhold and Archive Chart Cases, and the salvager trades one a week for 20 salvage.

She looks past the fire, at the black water. "Deep enough, and she stops being a ship."

Ask about the doors the crew sealed, the Haul, the Mender's hold, or what lies under Crownhold.

nextObjectiveId.text: What did the crew seal shut?

objectives.description:
"Soak a sealed chart in Core Rot and the rot remembers the place worse."

Use an Epic chart from your inventory with 3 Core Rot, then win one fight. You get the tainted chart: a harder run where you pick 2 rewards. Lose, and the chart comes back but the Rot is spent. Core Rot drops from the endgame Wreck, the low-tide runs, The Fall and the tainted runs.

"Some come back from the deep with a lantern that won't go out. It points at the mountain, at Crownhold, the castle she sailed from. Someone still gives orders there."

A Lastlight Lantern opens Crownhold. It drops from the Epic and tainted runs and rarely from the endgame Wreck and Archive Chart Cases, and, from level 80, the salvager trades one a week.

"Some bring back a ledger page or a stores list and go after holds no chart shows. They come back heavy, or not at all."

A page opens The Haul: up to 5 steps of crate, locker or cut through. Deeper, bigger chests of profession materials. Leave after any step to keep them; lose a fight and you keep nothing. Pages drop from the endgame Wreck and the Rare runs.

"Down in the lower hold, the ship's carpenter is still at work. He mends the hold shut around anything that doesn't belong. That's you."

Chart of the Drowned Cradle: a Legendary run for level 81 and up, alone, in the Battle Arena. It drops rarely from the Skyglass Wreck and the Spoiled Hold.

nextObjectiveId.text: How do I get past him?

objectives.description:
"Mind your feet. The hull closes in a band at a time, and the seams light up first."

Three fights: his apprentice, the bilge crew, then The Hullbound Mender. Glowing seams mark the next band a turn early. Grown hull shuts off bloodline passives, healing and new buffs. A win pays salvage and a pick of rewards.

"Four of them brought me shards. Different hands, same glass. Lay them side by side and they ring."

Keel: the endgame Wreck. Crown: Crownhold. Tide: the Epic and tainted runs. Ledger: The Haul.

"Under Crownhold the stair stops where the rock does. Something beneath it listens back."

One of each shard opens The Mother of Echoes, the last fight, in the Battle Arena. Alone, over three battles; health and chakra carry with no refills. All four shards are spent when it starts; a loss returns nothing.

"Beat her, and the shore will know it. Some names stick."

Winning The Mother of Echoes grants the title The Unstilled.

"Bring me what you pull off her. Brass, glass, rope. I pay in charts."

Every Skyglass win pays Wreck Salvage, and so does her shore work. Trade it to her for more charts. It keeps between weekends and can't be traded to other players.

nextObjectiveId.text: How much does a win pay?
Can I trade what I find?

objectives.description:
"The far hull pays best. The near half gives little, and not every time."

Skyglass Wreck: 3. Faded Wreck: 1, one clear in four. Chart runs by rarity: common 1, one win in four; rare 1; epic and Haul pages 3; legendary 5. Crownhold: 10. Watch Log challenge: 3. Dailies: 1 to 5.

"Four pieces for a deck chart. Pick the one you want."

Deck chart, 4 salvage: Tide Chart (opens The Low Tide Run), Watch Roster (The Night Watch), or the Buried Cache or Rotted Galley chart, each opening the run of its name.

"Ten for one from the hold. The crew drew those deeper."

Hold chart, 10 salvage: the Drowned Foundry, Quarantined Archive, Captain's Watch, Glass Nursery or Spoiled Hold chart. Each opens the run of the same name.

"The sealed charts and the Lantern, once a week. I don't find many."

Sealed chart, 20, once a week: a Reliquary Seal (opens The Sealed Reliquary) or The Last Heading (The Fall). Lastlight Lantern, 30, once a week, level 80: opens Crownhold.

"Clear my nets and I'll pay you. Something's always tangled in them."

Take a trade from the Wake Island board, from level 30. The salvage is taken when you start. Beat the Netted Husk, then pick your chart. Back out before the fight and she gives it all back.

"Shore work, if you want it. Echoes on the tideline, warm glass in the pools, wreck to comb, and a warden still counting."

Four dailies from her in sector 210, open to all: Beachcombing pays 1 salvage, Warm Glass 2, Echoes Ashore 3, The Tideline Count 5. Lose a fight and the run ends.

"One job at a time. Whatever the tide brought in."

Find her in sector 210. She offers one of the four: Beachcombing 40%, Warm Glass 30%, Echoes Ashore 20%, The Tideline Count 10%. Each offer uses one of your 20 daily NPC rolls, shared with every NPC. You hold one at a time: finish or drop it to roll again.

"What you can't use, trade. Every chart and every shard has a buyer."

Charts, Core Rot, Haul pages, shards and Skyglass Tokens can be traded. Crown's Hoard, Unmarked Cargo, Wreck Salvage, the Haul's chests and some once-only rewards cannot.

"The crew's colors still take to steel."

A Skyglass Token unlocks one Skyglass skin, once, on a weapon you already own: Aetherion, Thornsilver, Night's Testament, Stormrender, Oathbinder, Ink of the Void, The Unwritten, Gaea's Embrace, Warden's Bracers, Eclipsed Dawnblade, Zephyr's Whisper or Yuki's Frostbite. A boss's own token unlocks that boss's skin.

"I keep their watch log. It washes up a page at a time. I dry one each weekend and pin it up in the Administration Building."

Two pages go up each weekend: one for levels 30 to 80, one for 81 and up. Your band's Wreck Sighted hands you yours. Take it first: only what you do while you carry it counts.

"One watch's orders. Lately the name at the top isn't one of theirs."

Five challenges, in any order. Each pays its reward plus 3 Wreck Salvage; claim it from your Logbook. Finish all five for a Skyglass Token. The page closes Monday 6 PM Central (00:00 UTC Tuesday).
Back to the fire
She turns back to her net. "Go on, then. The tide won't wait on talk."
You leave the fire.
